notes:
Company background:
- Mid-market B2B SaaS (customer support platform) with ~350 employees, heavy chat volume during US business hours.
- Primary product: customer support chat + ticketing. Looking to add LLM-powered assistant for agents to suggest replies, summarize conversations, and automate ticket routing.
Use-case + requirements:
- Plan: evaluate Hosted API first (fast time-to-value) -> migrate to Dedicated once predictable throughput/latency needed.
- Workload: support-agent chat workloads (agent-assist + responder), streaming required for best UX.
- Latency SLO: <1.5s first-token for 95th pct under typical load; burst protection/queueing strategy required.
- Concurrency target for POC: 40-60 concurrent agent sessions; avg response length ~120-200 tokens. Expected peak throughput ~150 req/s during busy hour.
- Tool calling: require CRM lookup (customer profile) and ticket create/update calls from model (outbound tool hooks). Need examples of safe tool invocation patterns and structured output enforcement.
- Model preferences: open to Redwood-curated LLaMA-3 / instruction-tuned variants if latency/cost tradeoff is good. Also asked about auto-fallback to smaller models for cost/latency during spikes.
Security & compliance:
- Requires SOC2 attestation, SSO (SAML) integration, audit logs, and customer-managed KMS for secrets. Data residency non-blocker today but procurement wants retention policy options.
POC plan (agreed):
- 2-week POC on Hosted API.
- Phase 1 (week 1): integrate streaming SDK into agent UI, verify tool-calls (CRM lookup + ticket create), validate first-token latency <1.5s at 50 concurrent sessions in staging traffic replay.
- Phase 2 (week 2): load testing to 150 req/s, measure 95p latency, collect cost telemetry, evaluate caching/batching suggestions from Redwood Optimize.
- Success criteria: 95p first-token <=1.5s, correct tool-invocations in 98% of test cases, cost estimates within forecasted ARR band.
Sales/contract notes:
- Pricing sensitivity: mid-market budget, prefers committed monthly tier if we can show 20-30% cost improvement vs current vendor.
- Wants clear pricing for Dedicated transition and burst capacity.
- Legal requested standard DPA + SOC2 report.
Quotes & paraphrases:
- "We need streaming to feel real-time for our agents — anything >1.5s and CX complains."
- "If POC proves, we'll evaluate Dedicated for peak reliability within 6 months."
Open items / follow-ups:
- Provide POC checklist + sample streaming integration guide (action: SE to share by 2026-02-28).
- Confirm default retention settings and KMS workflow for Hosted API.
- Provide pricing scenario for 50 concurrent users vs 150 concurrent users, including Dedicated committed tier + burst costs.
public_description: Customerly is evaluating Redwood Hosted API for agent-assist chat with streaming and tool-calling. POC planned to validate <1.5s first-token SLO; interested in Dedicated later for predictable throughput.
